s.note: Jenna's thirteenth birthday party in the basement
s.how: Pop 100g popcorn kernels and tip into a big bowl, discarding unpopped kernels. Melt 50g butter in a saucepan over low heat, add 250g marshmallows and stir until smooth. Pour over the popcorn with 100g chopped sour straps and 80g jelly beans and fold quickly. With buttered hands, press into 12 tennis ball sized rounds. Set on baking paper for 30 minutes, then wrap in cellophane.

s.note: the wishing dust from Matt's dream house
s.how: Beat 200g butter with 150g sugar and an egg, then mix in 300g flour. Chill, roll and cut into rounds. Bake at 180C for 10 minutes and cool. Ice pale pink with icing sugar and a drop of colouring, then dust with edible glitter like wishing dust.

m.how: Stir-fry 500g sliced chicken thighs until browned. Add broccoli florets and a sliced red capsicum and cook 3 minutes. Toss through 400g cooked egg noodles with soy sauce and honey until sticky. Pack into takeaway boxes.

w.note: the cake at Jenna's thirteenth birthday
w.how: Heat the oven to 175C. Beat 200g soft butter and 200g caster sugar until pale, then 4 eggs one at a time and 1 tsp vanilla. Fold in 250g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Divide between two lined 20cm tins and bake 30 minutes. Cool. Beat 250g butter with 450g icing sugar, 2 tbsp milk and a drop of pink colouring. Sandwich the layers with 150g raspberry jam, ice all over and press sprinkles around the sides.

d.how: Blend 500ml pineapple juice with 200ml coconut cream and a big handful of ice until thick and smooth. Pour into glasses for the kids. Add 30ml white rum to each glass for the grown-ups who turned thirty overnight.
